subject: Proposal: 2-week bridge + unit-based surge for OpsLytics evaluation
messages:
From: Danielle Park <danielle@opslytics.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:13:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — 2-week bridge & surge headroom for our live test

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Our integration team is ready to run the live ingestion test next week, but we are short on time and need an additional two weeks of elevated capacity (primarily burst inference for prompt-heavy flows). Can you outline what a short-term bridge would look like from Redwood's side — either a credit top-up or a surge pack — and ballpark pricing so I can take it to procurement?

Key constraints:
- We need predictable burst headroom (up to ~500k tokens over 2 weeks).
- Procurement prefers a time-boxed offering that can convert to a subscription credit if we proceed.
- Legal wants one simple SOW or amendment we can sign quickly.

Appreciate a fast turnaround — we’re hoping to start the live test 9/20.

Thanks,
Danielle Park
Head of Integrations, OpsLytics
D: +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 2-week bridge & surge headroom for our live test

Hi Danielle — great to hear the integration is moving into a live step. We can support a short, time-boxed bridge that also gives you an easy path to convert value into committed credits if OpsLytics decides to expand. Two pragmatic options below; I included an appendix (short) with the exact units and conversion mechanics.

Option A — Surge Pack (recommended)
- 2-week, unit-based surge pack for 500k tokens (usable only for this POC window)
- Price: $1,750 total (equivalent to $0.0035 / token)
- Conversion: If OpsLytics signs a 6-month commit within 30 days of purchase, 25% of the surge pack value converts to a prepay credit toward the commit.
- Cap: total per-minute token rate protections in appendix; no overage without approval.

Option B — Time-boxed credit top-up
- 2-week flat credit: $2,000 in hosted credits (flexible use across tokens/embeddings)
- No conversion credit; cheaper to start but not convertible to committed credit.

Operational notes:
- We’ll produce a 1-page SOW amendment for either option (SOW + DocuSign link).
- We can attach a short appendix that shows how tokens map to estimated inference minutes for your current prompts.
- I’ve CC’d Marissa and Priyom for pricing/legal coordination.

If you’re ok with Option A I’ll send a DocuSign and the appendix; if procurement prefers Option B we’ll issue the credit invoice.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-2244

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: OpsLytics — pricing options for 2-week bridge (need approval on conversion %)

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Danielle's ask and the two options I proposed. Procurement will likely push for lower $/token. Thought on commercial trade-offs below:

- OpsLytics is small but live test is a high-visibility reference if it succeeds. Our list rate for short-term surge is $0.005 / token. I proposed $0.0035 (30% off list) to keep it low-friction but still preserve economics for short-term usage.
- Conversion credit (25% of pack value) smooths procurement handoff and gives us conversion leverage. If we make the conversion >30% we lose the leash.
- If legal wants simpler paperwork, we can do a flat credit and waive conversion, but then we lose the conversion incentive.

Recommendation: approve Option A as-is (500k tokens at $0.0035; 25% convert-to-credit on 6-month commit). If we need more flexibility, we can add a hard cap and an emergency manual top-up path.

Can we finalize numbers Monday and I’ll send the DocuSign?

— Hannah
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 14:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OpsLytics — pricing options for 2-week bridge (need approval on conversion %)

Hannah / Priyom — I’m fine with Option A with a small tweak to the conversion mechanics. Suggested final commercial: 

- Surge pack: 500k tokens at $0.0035 / token = $1,750 total.
- Convert-to-credit: 30% of surge pack value converts to prepay credit if OpsLytics signs a 6-month hosted commitment >= $25k within 45 days. (Raise the conversion to 30% but make it conditional on a minimum commit.)
- Add explicit one-time SOW amendment template and a 5-business-day acceptance window on the DocuSign.

Rationale: the higher conversion rate will make procurement more willing to sign a 6-month commit; the $25k threshold prevents gaming and preserves our economics. Priyom — if you’re ok with the threshold, I’ll mark this approved and Hannah can send.

Marissa
VP, ARR Expansion

Offer (final)
- Surge pack: 500,000 POC tokens for a 14-calendar day window (valid only for this POC).
- Price: $1,750 (unit price = $0.0035 / token).
- Conversion: 30% of the surge pack value ($525) converts into a prepay credit if OpsLytics signs a 6-month hosted commitment of at least $25,000 within 45 days of purchase.
- Invoice / SOW: attached 1-page SOW amendment + Appendix (OpsLytics_POC_Surge_Appendix.pdf). We’ll send a DocuSign link you can sign today; once signed we’ll provision the surge pack and email you the usage dashboard.

Notes & next steps:
1) If procurement prefers a flat credit instead of the conversion mechanic, reply and we’ll issue a $2,000 time-boxed credit invoice instead (no conversion).
2) If you expect the burst to exceed 500k tokens, let us know — we can add an emergency surge top-up at the same unit price with prior approval.
3) Please review the attached appendix that maps your average prompt mix to token consumption so you can validate the 500k estimate.
